description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseEvent' which serves as the base class for all event objects within the system. It includes properties such as event ID, code, value, and timestamp, along with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and utility functions for handling service IDs.

classes.name: BaseEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a general event, providing common properties and methods for serializing to and from JSON, and managing event metadata.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the event timestamp using milliseconds.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the event timestamp using seconds and nanoseconds.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the event timestamp directly using a Date object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event for debugging.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes the event from a JSON object.
